purpose: Permanently retain the identity, integrity bindings, recovery path, and redistribution boundary of the completed MetaSyn ID-only Actions artifact without copying third-party text whose redistribution terms are not inherited from MetaSyn's project-authored MIT annotations.

redistribution.reason: The audited MetaSyn licence is MIT only for project-authored annotations. Third-party article metadata, abstracts, identifiers, source-review excerpts, and PMC-derived text retain upstream terms, so this repository does not assume that the mixed raw Actions snapshot may be redistributed wholesale.

recovery.before_expiry: Fetch Actions artifact 9270589591 and require its downloaded ZIP SHA-256 to equal artifact_sha256 before use.
recovery.after_expiry: Reconstruct from the pinned MetaSyn code revision and dataset revision under their upstream terms, then require public_reviews_sha256, results_tree_sha256, and official_evaluation_sha256 to match before treating the reconstruction as the same run content.

interpretation.preserved: Exact artifact identity and the content bindings needed to verify a retained or reconstructed copy.
not_claimed: inferential superiority over a matched external baseline
a permanent redistribution right for MetaSyn third-party content
